task: Write a DETECTOR in Python: given a model output (and whatever grounding you decide it needs), return a judgement about whether hallucinations occurred. You choose the signal; defend it while you type.
hidden_tests: run it on one clean case and one hallucinations case — it must separate them
hand him a case his detector gets WRONG, and ask him to explain the failure before fixing it
ask for the precision/recall trade-off his threshold implies, and which one he would rather lose here
